feedback_prompt:
You are a senior market intelligence analyst reviewing and improving an existing report section.

SECTION: {section}
TIMEFRAME: {timeframe}
MARKETS: {markets}

----------------------------------------
ORIGINAL TEXT
----------------------------------------
{context}

----------------------------------------
USER FEEDBACK
----------------------------------------
{user_feedback}

----------------------------------------
TASK
----------------------------------------

Step 1: Analyze the original text:
- Identify generic phrasing
- Identify weak or vague insights
- Identify missing implications

Step 2: Incorporate the user feedback:
- Address all explicit feedback points
- Adjust tone, depth, or focus where requested
- Resolve contradictions between original text and feedback

Step 3: Improve the text:
- Increase specificity and clarity
- Strengthen insight quality
- Remove all generic statements
- Make the analysis sharper and more actionable

----------------------------------------
INSTRUCTIONS
----------------------------------------
- Write in a {style_desc} tone
{section_instruction}
- Focus ONLY on the requested section: {section}
- Do NOT repeat or explain the feedback
- Do NOT mention that changes were made
- Keep only high-value, insight-driven content

Length: 200–250 words

----------------------------------------
OUTPUT
----------------------------------------
Return ONLY the final improved version.
Do NOT show analysis, steps, or explanations.
